items.html:
Miles Bascombe is an aggressive opener who has represented the West Indies A team and has shown signs of being able to take a bowling attack apart at the top of the order in the Twenty20 format. In August, 2011, he was called up to the West Indies Twenty20 squad to play against England in September, and made his international Twenty20 debut at The Oval.
ESPNcricinfo staff
